title: Paper Replications and Experiments
description:
Paper Replications and Experiments collects three kinds of work: from-scratch PyTorch replications of classic and state-of-the-art AI/ML papers (transformer variants, attention mechanisms, GANs, diffusion models, CLIP-style vision-language models, LoRA and MoE fine-tuning); SmolHub, six small language models of 88M to 200M parameters trained end to end with full pipelines, from tokenizer through pretraining, SFT and DPO; and post-training experiments, including SFT and GRPO runs.
